usedFor: Amazon Seller Central holds your marketplace orders and Freshsales Classic receives each one as a deal through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: Every new order becomes a deal your sales team can follow, linked to an account.

watchOut: “New Refund” also feeds “Create Deal”, so a refund opens a deal unless you route it to “Update Deal”.
